purpose: Named database persistence design review. Native storage contracts, offline request conformance, backup coverage and live recovery are separate claims. No live certification is established by this matrix.

providers.nativeCreate: GraphQL templateDeployV2 for the reviewed official PostgreSQL template in the exact project/environment
providers.durability: PostgreSQL data directory must be inside the observed attached volume; image, service name and icon do not prove this.
providers.identity: projectId, environmentId, serviceId and attached volume identity
providers.completion: Wait for the exact template workflow Complete result, then observe exact service instance, attachment and mount/data-directory alignment before reporting a usable persistent database.
providers.recovery: Preserve existing identity and data on unknown reads; a missing or wrong mount requires reviewed recovery, never automatic replacement or an empty-volume attachment.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized project/environment, reviewed official database template, volume capacity and scoped private runtime references.
providers.coverage: Pinned GraphQL transport and database persistence regressions; no live restart/data-retention proof.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: Exact scoped service variable names select the existing direct connection reference; only an absent local variable-name marker can be normalized through the isolated database-bindings stage. No credential values are persisted or fingerprinted.

providers.durability: Each hosted project has a dedicated PostgreSQL instance and provider-managed database disk.
providers.identity: project reference with organization identity and region
providers.completion: Observe database readiness on the exact project; create acknowledgement alone is insufficient.
providers.recovery: Retain exact acknowledged project or unresolved-create state; project deletion deletes its database. Backup entitlement is separate.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized organization id and provider-returned slug, available region and plan entitlement.
providers.coverage: Pinned OpenAPI create request and serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback checks; disk contents and live recovery unverified.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: Branches own database state in durable storage separated from replaceable or suspended compute endpoints.
providers.identity: organization, project and branch; endpoint identity is not the durable data identity
providers.completion: Wait for the create operations and exact project/endpoint readiness before connection use.
providers.recovery: Non-idempotent ambiguous create must retain exact project or unresolved scope; compute suspension is not data deletion. Branch history is not a tested restore.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized organization, region and project allowance.
providers.coverage: Pinned OpenAPI request and serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback checks; live storage and retention unverified.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: Cloud SQL owns database storage; the adapter provisions a native instance with provider-default disk settings, not a Cloud Run container.
providers.identity: cloud project and instance name, with region and provider connection name
providers.completion: Correlate operation completion with exact instance RUNNABLE state, engine and region.
providers.recovery: Retain exact instance/unresolved attempt after uncertain creation; backups and PITR configuration require separate observed recovery evidence.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized cloud project, SQL Admin API, billing, regional capacity and workload connectivity.
providers.coverage: Serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback check and existing lifecycle tests; disk sizing is a native default, no live durability proof.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: RDS PostgreSQL uses EBS for database/log storage; the adapter requests 20 GiB gp3 encrypted storage.
providers.identity: AWS account, region and DB instance identifier/ARN
providers.completion: Wait for the exact available instance, endpoint and approved workload-network attachment.
providers.recovery: Preserve exact instance and owned security-group recovery state on uncertainty; backup retention is distinct from a recoverable snapshot and tested restore.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized account/region and exact applied ECS network, security groups and database capacity.
providers.coverage: Existing adapter SDK-command lifecycle tests; this review does not add RDS create wire-schema validation or live persistence evidence.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: Flexible Server uses Azure managed disks; the adapter requests 32 GiB storage with auto-grow enabled.
providers.identity: Full server ARM id including subscription and resource group
providers.completion: Observe the exact server Ready, approved placement/SKU, database and firewall readiness.
providers.recovery: Preserve scoped server identity after uncertain PUT; destructive restoration and backup points remain separate from server readiness.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized subscription and owned applied Container Apps resource group, supported region/SKU and runtime network access.
providers.coverage: Serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback check and existing lifecycle tests; live disk/backup/restore unverified.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: Fly Managed Postgres cluster owns database storage; the adapter requests 10 GiB, not a PostgreSQL app Machine.
providers.identity: Organization slug and Managed Postgres cluster id
providers.completion: Wait for exact cluster ready with expected organization, name, region and plan before database/user initialization.
providers.recovery: MPG cluster survives application deletion. Preserve exact cluster/unresolved-create evidence; do not switch to unmanaged Fly Postgres on failure.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized organization, supported MPG plan/region and private network connectivity. Machines MPG API applies to v2 clusters; v1 remains outside this API contract.
providers.coverage: Serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback check and existing lifecycle tests; successful live MPG provisioning and restore unverified.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: This native managed-database adapter does not expose service-variable reference metadata normalization. Its independently reviewed connection URL/runtime projection remains unchanged; no Railway-style variable name is inferred.

providers.durability: Managed PostgreSQL cluster size includes database disk capacity; the adapter does not provision an App Platform development database or app container.
providers.identity: Account UUID, cluster UUID and region
providers.completion: Wait for the exact cluster online, then initialize the requested logical database.
providers.recovery: Retain exact acknowledged cluster or unresolved-create state; automatic backup product capability is not evidence a particular recovery point exists.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized account, managed-database create/read permissions and supported region/size/version.
providers.coverage: Serialized rejected-create/no-hosting-fallback check and existing lifecycle tests; successful live provisioning and retained recovery points unverified.
